nodes.description: External function that verifies/knows a relay staker address by emitting RelayAddressVerified with the caller address, workchain id and address body.
Caller address supplied by the transaction; cast to uint160 and used as the verified relay eth_addr.
int8 workchain identifier passed by the caller and emitted in the event.
uint256 body of the staker address passed by the caller and emitted in the event.
Event emission RelayAddressVerified(uint160(msg.sender), workchain_id, address_body) recording unauthenticated caller-controlled data on-chain.

edges.reason: msg.sender is cast to uint160 and written into the emitted event payload, so untrusted caller data reaches the emission operation.
The caller-supplied workchain_id parameter is emitted verbatim in the event payload.
The caller-supplied address_body parameter is emitted verbatim in the event payload.
Execution of the external function body always reaches the event emission statement.
workchain_id is consumed by the function's execution as an external argument.
address_body is consumed by the function's execution as an external argument.
msg.sender is read inside the function body to build the emitted value.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter only exists as an input binding of the function and its value flows straight into the event emission; it can be folded into the function node.
